summary: Map service workflows, design human handoffs and assess customer-facing AI controls. Explore the five-day course and plan your next step.
lede: Customer experience automation training covers redesigning service workflows from contact triage to agent support and complaint resolution. It is for CX operations leads, contact-centre managers, service designers and process analysts who need to choose automation opportunities and assess their effects on service. You will map workflows with BPMN 2.0, create routing and human-escalation rules, and develop service measures and a staged implementation roadmap, including review of AI-generated responses.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape, operate or assess customer service workflows involving automation or AI. It suits intermediate learners with experience in customer service, CX operations, contact centres or process improvement.
modules: NIST AI Risk Management Framework Controls
prerequisites: Working knowledge of customer service, CX operations or contact-centre workflows is expected. Basic process-mapping experience is helpful; programming is not required.
